q1_issues.issue: (Inheritance well_attended attended) decomposes a compound ADJECTIVE, which the Compound-concepts section says to leave opaque — its decomposition licences cover compound kinds, compound actions, phrasal verbs and agent-nominalizations only.

q2_gaps: hyphenated adverb + participle compound adjective ('well-attended'): no stated rule on whether it gets a genus atom or stays one opaque property symbol
notes: 'each night' → (Time e night) + (Every e 1 day) with no status atom matches the 'every morning' habitual pattern exactly, 'a small heap of threads' matches the flock-of-birds shape with 'small' licensed as a property of the collection itself, and the indefinite subject correctly stays a witness (a verbal generic needs a bare plural or explicit quantifier). Roles are right: transitive inanimate subject stays Agent, and the yielded heap is created so it is Patient.
